# Cultural Peace

> Cultural Peace presents 14 principles for managing political polarization, protecting innocent people during cultural conflict, and supporting civil discourse.

## Principles and resources

- [Overview](https://www.culturalpeace.org/): Introduction to the Cultural Peace initiative.
- [14 principles](https://www.culturalpeace.org/#principles): Principles and their supporting explanations.
- [Resources](https://www.culturalpeace.org/links.html): Curated reading, videos, tools, and organizations related to polarization and cultural peace.
- [Contact](https://www.culturalpeace.org/contact.html): Questions, feedback, and collaboration.
